notes: Universal companion AI 0.8.6 DYNAMIC UI. Companion panel now hides unavailable actions completely instead of showing grey/NO buttons: Parry, Rage, Turn Undead, Traps, Locks, Stealth and caster rows appear only when the selected companion actually has the relevant feat/skill/class. AUTO and FOLLOW remain universal. Empty action rows collapse. Buff strip window is widened/tallened so spell icons are not clipped by scrollbars, and the transparent strip content is hidden when no active non-hostile spell buffs exist. Preserves 0.8.5 tactical offhand/shield logic, 0.8.4 prepared-spell fixes and 0.8.3 autoheal.
